title: Ethereal Demon in Tangled Wires
description: A dark demonic creature with glowing purple energy lines crouches in the center of a chaotic mass of twisted metallic wires and branches. Bright blue and cyan electrical energy crackles through the tangled structure on the left side, illuminating the dark, textured environment.
prompt: A menacing demonic beast with glowing purple energy lines along its body crouches amidst a chaotic tangle of twisted metallic wires, branches and debris. Bright blue and cyan electrical arcs and sparks crackle through the dense web of dark material on the left, dramatic volumetric lighting, moody dark fantasy atmosphere, highly detailed textured painting
